source("analysis/scripts/spray_infection.R")
library(here)
raw_dir <- here("raw")
raw_file <- "spray_infections.xlsx"

my_order <- c(
  "Guy11",
  "Δmst7",
  "MST7-GFP 9.2",
  "MST7-GFP 12.2",
  "MST7S358D-GFP 1.1",
  "MST7S358D-GFP 3.1",
  "MST7S358A-GFP 1.3",
  "MST7S358A-GFP 3.5"
)

my_reps <- c(1,2,3)   # for example, only biorep 1 and 3


plot_genotype_boxplot(
    file.path(raw_dir, raw_file),
    genotype_order = my_order,
    reps = my_reps)
